_notes: 18869/18870/18871/18872/18873: Vulgate Ps 67 → 思高 Ps 68; 18874–18878: Vulgate Ps 68 → 思高 Ps 69. Fetched 思高 text directly. 18871 antiphon uses only first clause of 思高 68:27 (在盛会中赞美天主). 18872 'Mirabilis Deus in sanctis suis' rendered from 思高 68:36 ('在圣所中显得可敬可畏') as no exact 'mirabilis' wording appears; closest 思高 phrase used. 18875 'Propter inimicos meos éripe me' is antiphon adapted from 思高 69:19 last clause. 18876 'Quaerite Dominum et vivet anima vestra' is antiphon text; adapted from 思高 69:33 ('寻求天主的人，你们的心必要兴奋'). 18882 'Facti sumus sicut consolati': 思高 Ps 126:1 has '仿佛是在梦中' not 'consolati'; rendered as 仿佛在梦中 per 思高. 18883 is a composite liturgical antiphon (not straight scripture), combining Jn 1:1 concept with Salvátor mundi; translated liturgically. 18884 adapted from Lk 2:11 (思高: 今天在达味城中，为你们诞生了一位救世者，他是主默西亚). 18887 'Exaltáre qui iudicas terram': Vulgate Ps 93:2 → 思高 Ps 94:2; * placed after first clause following Latin position. 18888–18889: split of 思高 Ps 94:12 across two versicle lines.
